# pcd_identity_application_credential (Resource)

Manages an application credential for the authenticated user. Application credentials are immutable — any change forces a new resource.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "pcd_identity_application_credential" "example" {
  name        = "tf-example-app-cred"
  description = "Application credential managed by Terraform"
  roles       = ["member"]
  expires_at  = "2027-01-01T00:00:00Z"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the application credential.

### Optional

- `description` (String) A description of the application credential.
- `expires_at` (String) RFC3339 expiry timestamp. If omitted, the credential does not expire.
- `region` (String) The region. Defaults to the provider's region.
- `roles` (Set of String) Role names the credential is limited to. Defaults to all of the user's roles.
- `secret` (String, Sensitive) The secret. If omitted, one is generated and returned on create only.
- `unrestricted` (Boolean) Whether the credential may be used to create/delete other application credentials and trusts.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The application credential ID.
- `project_id` (String) The project the credential is scoped to.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
terraform import pcd_identity_application_credential.example <id>
```
